t: A tiny Arduino camera board that spots objects and runs small vision AI.
steps: Buy the board from the Arduino Store or a shop such as Micro Center.
Download and install the free OpenMV IDE on your computer.
Plug the board into your computer with a micro USB cable.
Open the OpenMV IDE and connect to the board. Let the IDE update the firmware if it asks.
Open the Hello World camera example and press run. You will see a live picture in the IDE.
Try the face detection example next and watch it draw boxes around faces.
Later, install the Arduino IDE and add the mbed Nicla board package to write Arduino sketches.
meta: Open Board. From $52.13. A few stores.
